transformations.edit: Extracted the target-local IterMut representation from frozen Rust source with field names, order, and privacy preserved.

Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus method whose target body preserves the Rust 1.96 unsafe expression `from_raw_parts_mut(self.ptr.as_ptr(), len!(self))`; only return naming and the generated ensures clause were added.

Modeled `len!(self)` as a target-local executable macro wrapper over `len_bang(&self)`, with the ZST/non-ZST pointer-distance computation recorded as a source-backed boundary rather than expanded recursively.

Modeled `from_raw_parts_mut(data, len)` as the narrow raw-parts/provenance boundary mapping the pointer and `len!` result to the returned mutable slice view; the target function itself is not external_body and the postcondition is not assumed directly.
